rationale: Charlie is building Expo as the universal platform for mobile and web app development, while Peter has spent 18+ years architecting clinical-grade health apps—a domain that demands both rapid iteration and reliability. Peter's deep expertise in mobile health AI (cardiac monitoring, diabetes detection) and wearables could benefit from Expo's cross-platform speed and developer accessibility, especially as Charlie believes AI is expanding who can build software; conversely, Peter's clinical validation and embedded systems background in a high-stakes domain could inform how Expo serves regulated industries.
intro_message: Charlie Cheever, meet Peter Kuhar — Charlie's scaling Expo as the default platform for mobile and web apps, and Peter's built 18+ years of clinical health apps on mobile; there's potential overlap in how fast-iteration frameworks serve high-stakes health domains.
